invariants.rationale: The method decreases y in each loop iteration, and returns y, so the returned value should not increase compared to the input y.
Within the method, y is repeatedly decremented from the initial value. Since this.y is not modified, result is likely to be less than or equal to the initial this.y.
The method operates on nodes and expects it to be non-null.
plusMinusWidth is used as an offset in x calculations, and such offsets in GUI code are typically non-negative.
Array.size is always non-negative in LibGDX arrays.
